name: smallwebapps
description: Free, fast, private browser-based tools for PDF, images, development, data, and YouTube tasks. No accounts, no uploads, no servers.
author: Lucas Diniz

scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm build && pnpm dlx wrangler pages deploy ./apps/web/dist --project-name=smallwebapps --commit-dirty=true
scripts.prepare: git config --get core.hooksPath >/dev/null 2>&1 || git config core.hooksPath .githooks 2>/dev/null || true
